description: TVOC (including Benzene and Formaldehyde) was measured at 9.99 mg/m3 on the upper floor — the sensor's maximum reading. The WHO limit is 3 mg/m3. The Benzene source was traced to a gasoline tank used as a urine container in the bathroom.
response: The gasoline-tank container was removed; Benzene levels improved. TVOC remained elevated due to off-gassing from hab materials — not fully resolved.
lesson: Never store fuel vessels inside the hab. Conduct a TVOC baseline measurement on arrival before sleeping in the hab. Bring a TVOC meter with Benzene/Formaldehyde disaggregation. Have an emergency ventilation plan ready.
pattern_tag: VOC off-gassing / fuel vessel stored indoors
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.4 Scientific incidents, lines 695-700. Register Crew tag: 'C15'. Sol: not stated; the lesson recommends a Day 1 baseline TVOC measurement, used as a proxy for when this was likely measured. Confidence (A) rationale: precise instrument reading with a cited WHO reference limit — formal engineering/science measurement report.
